scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @lumen/api-contract build && concurrently -k -n service,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @lumen/local-service dev" "pnpm --filter @lumen/web dev"
scripts.test:e2e-smoke: pnpm --filter @lumen/api-contract build && pnpm --filter @lumen/local-service build && pnpm --filter @lumen/web test:e2e-smoke
scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
